name: Cheap
table_rule_text: Everything you buy in Cyberpunk RED falls into one of eight Price Categories, which determines their Market Price. If you aren't a Fixer, forget about getting it cheaper. If it's Expensive and you don't know a Fixer, forget about getting it at all. Without the help of an experienced Fixer or one of their Night Markets, only items up to Premium can be purchased.
